payload.title: Deploy on merge: CMS app builds main automatically, no personal credentials
payload.description: Enable auto-build on the CMS Amplify app's main branch in the app-shell template (or a GitHub Actions workflow with an OIDC role, like Sierrendipity's CI). Merging to main must deploy the backend with no human AWS step. Find out why auto-build is off on d7s858igkyct5 before changing it. Done: a merged no-op PR on Anth.us-Papyrus produces a successful CMS main job without anyone starting it.
